**Finding: missing (LOL-CAP)** — no liability cap, damages exclusion or aggregate-liability language exists anywhere in the Agreement (Warranties §9 is limited to authority reps and the Globix carve-out; §10.1–10.8 are pure boilerplate). Both parties sit uncapped at law, which fails the fallback outright.

**Cure (fallback level, one insertion as new §10.9, within the surviving Section 10):** a mutual cap at fees paid or payable by the Company in the twelve months preceding the claim, with Excluded Claims — indemnification, confidentiality breach, gross negligence and wilful misconduct — outside the cap. All six fallback elements are met by that single operation; the preferred USD 1,000,000 floor, mutual consequential-damages exclusion and wider carve-out set were deliberately not volunteered.
